title: Conditioned Activation Transport for T2I Safety Steering

bias_targets.methodology: Generating images using contrastive safe/unsafe prompt pairs targeting racism, segregation, and white supremacy (from the SafeSteerDataset), and calculating the Attack Success Rate (ASR) using the ShieldGemma vision-language safety judge.
Evaluating model outputs on prompt pairs designed to elicit sexist caricatures and stereotypes of women in professional settings, using an automated safety classifier to measure violation rates.
Measuring the generation of age-related stereotypes (e.g., caricatures of narcissistic youth) using specific prompt pairs and evaluating the unsafe generation rate via the ShieldGemma model.
Testing the text-to-image model's propensity to generate classist caricatures based on contrastive prompt pairs, evaluated with an automated safety judge.
